integrity: Exhaustiveness uses the published fact that the Fibonacci word is Sturmian, hence has exactly N+1 length-N factors. The bundled checker regenerates N+1 observed factors at N=18 and N=40 and verifies every relevant block partition. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The result determines only the uniform Fibonacci antipower radii for k=3 and k=4. It does not give a formula or improved asymptotic constant for larger k.
title: Exact first two nontrivial Fibonacci antipower radii
